reviews_reference_check.name: reviews_reference_check
reviews_reference_check.value: "app"."reviews"."offering_id" is not null or ("app"."reviews"."course_id" is not null and "app"."reviews"."year" is not null and "app"."reviews"."term" is not null)

reviews_scores_check.name: reviews_scores_check
reviews_scores_check.value:
"app"."reviews"."assignment_score" between 1 and 5
				and "app"."reviews"."lecture_score" between 1 and 5
				and "app"."reviews"."exam_score" between 1 and 5
				and "app"."reviews"."satisfaction_score" between 1 and 10
